info.name: PM Client API
info.description:
Client, Client Category, and Service API endpoints for the Project Management module.

All endpoints require:
- Sanctum bearer token authentication
- `pm.client.read` permission

## Authentication

### Option A: Permanent Token (H2H / Server-to-Server)
1. Create an API User in **Auth > API Users** admin panel.
2. Copy the generated token (shown once).
3. Paste the token into the `access_token` collection variable.

### Option B: Login Flow (Interactive Users)
1. Run the **Login** request in the Auth folder.
2. The token is automatically saved to the `access_token` collection variable.

## Status Code Format
`"<http_code><service_code><response_code>"` as string.

| Service | Code |
|---------|------|
| Client List | 06 |
| Client Detail | 07 |
| Client Category List | 08 |
| Service List | 09 |
